title: Confirmed measles cases in the United States (cases per year)

source.name: Measles Cases and Outbreaks
source.publisher: U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention

notes: CDC confirmed-case totals: 2021 = 49, 2022 = 121, 2023 = 59, 2024 = 285, 2025 = 2,289 (the most since 1991, with 48 outbreaks). The 2026 figure of 2,566 is year-to-date through August 13, 2026, already the highest annual count since the United States declared measles eliminated in 2000; 94 percent of 2026 cases are outbreak-associated and 93 percent of people infected were unvaccinated or of unknown vaccination status.
